evidence.note: test_kernel.py is an explicit correctness ledger: sweeps 7 cases over shapes/dims/nomask and Normal+Cauchy, printing per-case allclose/frac_ok/maxabs and overall ALL OK/FAILED.
bench.py is an explicit latency ledger over all 10 timed shapes, computing WORST=max(medians) and printing the pass<=10400 gate — the exact worst-case-median metric the grader uses.
After nearly every optimization the agent runs test_kernel.py AND bench.py together, maintaining a coupled correctness+per-shape-latency picture instead of optimizing blind.
'Verify revert' and 'Verify back to 10616 baseline' show it tracks a numeric worst-case baseline and detects/undoes regressions.
Repeated per-stage profiling explicitly focused on the N=2048 shape — identifies and targets the binding worst-case shape that gates the latency score.

Detected an intermittent N=512 correctness failure introduced by optimizations, then systematically isolated it (checkone, 30x count, determinism check, iso2-iso6 stage tracing) — catching a cross-case regression and reallocating effort to the now-gating correctness bug.
Some residual thrash: a spawned contraction-tuning run (tune_ct2) was killed and replaced (tune_ct3), and profiling was repeated many times, short of clean early detection of stuck/circular states.

reasoning: The agent built and continuously ran dual ledgers — a per-case correctness sweep and a per-shape latency bench that computes the worst-case median against the 10400μs gate — pairing them after almost every change (steps 13, 21, 92, 101, 209). It identified and targeted the binding worst-case shape N=2048 (188, 256, 259), reverted regressions against a tracked baseline (154, 241), and caught a cross-case correctness regression at N=512 introduced by optimization, reallocating to isolate it (287-314). This matches anchor 8 strongly with partial anchor-10 reallocation, but residual thrash (275) and no clear early catching of circular states keeps it at 8. Confidence is medium because only tool arguments, not observations, were available.
